rules: Top 10 by first-5-minute volume vs normal (of ~105 liquid names), opening range 09:30-09:34 at least 0.35 of daily ATR, first 1-minute close outside it before 10:00, stop at the session extreme, target 2x risk, out by 15:55. 0.05% slippage a side.
sizing: Results are % of the account with a full stop costing 1%.
